invariants.description: Poiseuille resistance and thin-wall compliance: R = 8 mu l/(pi r_0^4), C = 2 pi r_0^3 l/(E h), h = r_0(a e^(b r_0) + c e^(d r_0)) (Avolio wall-thickness fit)
total volume q = q_0 + q_C with q_0 = pi r_0^2 l
invariants.expr: np.allclose(q_0, np.pi*r_0**2*l, rtol=1e-9) & np.allclose(q, q_0 + q_C, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30)

invariants.description: exact solution with constant BCs: u(t) = u_ss + (u(0) - u_ss) e^(-4t/(RC)), u_ss = (u_in + u_out)/2 (two R/2 halves around one compliance)
Ohm law on each half: v = 2(u_in - u)/R, v_d = 2(u - u_out)/R
invariants.expr: np.allclose(v*R, 2*(u_in - u), rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-8*abs(u_in)) & np.allclose(v_d*R, 2*(u - u_out), rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-8*abs(u_in))

invariants.description: volume balance: q_C(t) - q_C(0) = integral of (v - v_d)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(q_C - q_C[0] - np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*((v - v_d)[1:] + (v - v_d)[:-1])*np.diff(t))]))) <= (1e-3 + ((t[1] - t[0])/(R*C/4))**2/6)*np.max(np.abs(q_C - q_C[0])) + 1e-8*np.min(C)*np.max(np.abs(u))

bc_sweep.rationale: BCs span the reference pressure u_0 up to u_0 + 3 dp (dp = test pressure drop of the vessel class) and flows 0 to 3x the equilibrium flow dp/R; u_ext -1000..1000 Pa (tissue pressure); geometry, E, mu and the wall-thickness coefficients at 0.5-2x (the exact solution is re-evaluated at every point, so all invariants must hold across the whole region).

baseline.reason: no single-compartment data: an isolated 0D segment with constant BCs has no measured counterpart. Candidate for a network built from these components: pries1990blood rat-mesentery networks (segment diameters, lengths, measured velocities/pressures), or the boas2008vascular arteriole-capillary-venule chain (60 -> 25 mmHg); not set up
